title: Dockside Dreams | Near Gallatin Marina
description:
Welcome to your lake getaway in Gallatin! Located in Mariners Cove on Old Hickory Lake, this comfortable home is just a short walk from Gallatin Marina and Awedaddys Bar & Grill. Enjoy boating, fishing, lake views, waterfront dining, and live music, then relax on the private patio surrounded by mature trees. With a spacious bonus room and peaceful setting, it’s the perfect retreat for enjoying lake life near Nashville.

If interested ask about a boat that’s available.
